📍We have nothing new to say, and America cannot win Iran's trust unless it implements the seven conditions| Threats and military moves cannot sway the strategic decisions of the Islamic Republic🔖Mohammad-Baqer Qalibaf, in a meeting with Asim Munir held on Tuesday evening in Baharestan, noting the brotherly ties between Iran and Pakistan, expressed his appreciation and gratitude for the solidarity of the Pakistani nation and government, who stood by Iran in times of war and negotiation. 📌Field Marshal Asim Munir, too, in this meeting, while conveying the greetings of Mr. Ayaz Sadiq, Speaker of the National Assembly, and Shahbaz Sharif, Prime Minister of Pakistan, stressed the continuation of cooperation between the two countries.📌Asim Munir, responding to the follow-up by the Speaker of the Islamic Consultative Assembly on border exchanges between the two countries, said the border issues had been temporary and technical, and the border between the two countries has been open since today. 📌In this meeting, Dr. Qalibaf, referring to the negotiations that took place between Iran and the United States in Islamabad, said: There I told the Vice President of America plainly that the long record of America's hostile actions against Iran before and after our Islamic Revolution has left us at the peak of distrust toward America, and now, with the Trump administration's violation of the Islamabad understanding, his repeated threats have built this edifice of distrust even higher than before.📌We have nothing new to say, and America cannot win Iran's trust unless it implements the seven conditions set out by Iran, which were presented in New York. We are not warmongers, but we are fully prepared to defend📌 our homeland and our national dignity; threats and military moves cannot sway the strategic decisions of the Islamic Republic of Iran. It was America that, through miscalculation and war against Iran, fell into the quagmire, and now it is they who must take the necessary steps to get out.📍Information Base of Mohammad-Baqer Qalibaf▫️ Telegram | Twitter| Bale | Eitaa | Rubika| Aparat▫️Virasty | Farseman | Rubino| YouTube | ▫️Soroush▫️ @Ghalibaf🔗 Ghalibaf.ir
